home.cold.comment: Cold home loads the full ordered app module graph plus digest preview awareness on boot (aPreview). Digest-decouple train base measured ~436015 gzip wire bytes p95 in CI. T3 attachment related-notices adds ~0.8–1.2 KB gzip on the always-loaded path (alerts/routing/i18n/index chrome only); the related JSON artifact and client helper load only on attachment-bearing notice detail, not home cold. Two landed features re-baselined the ceiling from 440000 to 445000: the property-lens filter template (its inline lens/cluster CSS ships in home index.html) and the design-language token sheet (brand.css, loaded on every page). Measured p95 ~442801 after both; 445000 was the settled main ceiling. Rules association monitor pack + Alerts template chrome raised to 475000 (CI 20-sample p95 measured 471794 gzip wireBytes on tip 01c18c62). T2 structured-table UI is deferred (site/attachment_tables_ui.mjs dynamic-import from fillContext only); always-loaded residual is a small host/stub + i18n keys only (table markup and attachment_metadata_lookup.json are not on home cold). Historical T2 measures: pre-split 437417 vs 430000; post-deferral 443180 vs 440000. On this rebased tip, inherit main's 475000 — re-measure if CI flags. Ratchet target: under 435000 after a home-path load split that defers alerts preview awareness.
